# script to transfer files from the cluster to local machine
```{bash}
rsync -avh --progress  dmccluskey@10.0.7.5:/home/lab/dmccluskey/CARPALL_h5 ~/carpall_cellbender
```

# to transfer filtered matrices to my cellbender output files (so that they are available when a cellbender file is missing due to it failing)
```{bash}
rsync -avm --progress \
  --include='*/' \
  --include='filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5' \
  --exclude='*' \
  /Volumes/ritd-ag-project-rd01k9-tacco78/scRNAseq_data_CARPALL/ \
  ../carpall_cellbender/CARPALL_h5/
```
